annotations.title: Read and answer reviews of the person's templates

description: Lists the reviews of templates the person shares, newest first (hidden: reports hid its words from the page). With reviewId and reply, answers one as the template's author, once: answering again replaces it, and an empty reply takes it back. Up to 280 characters, no links; write the person's answer, not your own.
